message.reasoning_content: We need to determine charges. Primary charge likely 盗窃? But description: fraud, contract fraud, false representation, obtaining money via false pretenses, contract fraud (诈骗). The primary charge is likely 诈骗 (fraud). The companion charges list: 传授犯罪方法, 侵占, 引诱、教唆、欺骗他人吸毒, 持有、使用假币. None of these apply. So only 诈骗? Also maybe 合同诈骗? In examples they used 盗窃;非法持有毒品 etc. For contract fraud they used 盗窃;非法狩猎 earlier? Actually second example: they gave 盗窃;非法狩猎 for tree theft? That seems odd. But they sometimes include extra like 盗窃;非法狩猎 (maybe mis). For this case, they are defrauding contractors by false contracts. So charge: 诈骗. Possibly also 侵占? But 侵占 is appropriation of property entrusted? Not here. So answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>.
